comparison.objective: Read and log a fridge thermometer maximum before resetting it versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual reading, recording, and ordered button actuation versus fine mechanical adjustment, tool torque control, and iterative dynamic observation.
comparison.success_condition: Maximum must be logged before reset; candidate must achieve and retain two safe physical stops within explicit limits.
comparison.reason: Ordered control actuation is only a generic shared primitive; the task tests measurement logging, not physical calibration. Logging accuracy and reset rubric are absent.
